Messages.Author: Maxie_Zeus
Messages.Body:
For Gehenna

22 clans, 2 crypt cards per clan except the ones that have an
Advanced vampire, that's 44 normal crypt and 6 advanced, so far we
know there are:

Theo Bell
Hesha Ruhadze
Sascha Vykos
Jan Pieterzoon
Ferox

That's five, so who will be the sixth advanced minion for this
expansion? Caitiff, Giovanni, and Toreador (out of the question) are
the clans missing an advanced minion.
Place your bets.

Also to note, besides Ferox, no more bloodlines this set.

Messages.Author: John Flournoy
Messages.Body:
"David Wilson" <danceswithwolvesontopofabuildingareyous...@umich.edu> wrote in message news:<wvCec.3993$Nz2....@news.itd.umich.edu>...


The source was the Spanish advertisement for VtES Gehenna Boosters
that was posted to the newsgroup March 30th:
http://www.distrimagen.es/catalogo/book.asp?referencia=woc2651

Relevant Spanish text: "Incluye personajes de las novelas y del libro
Gehenna (Beckett, Ferox, Pieterzoon, Bell, Afifa, Ryder, Hector
Trelane, Giangaleazzo, Petra, Shahid, Vykos, Cyscek)."

In order, here's if this info is accurate as of this moment's
previews:

Beckett: still possible. List only covers clans from Malkavian through
Ventrue Antitribu, Gangrel's a G-letter.)
Ferox: Still possible (G-letter clan). Spoiler text from a CCG
magazine has appeared elsewhere, so very likely.
Pieterzoon: Confirmed.
Theo Bell: Still possible (B-letter)
Afifa: unknown. (don't recognize the vamp offhand)
Ryder: unknown. (don't recognize the vamp offhand)
Hector Trelane: Confirmed.
Giangaleazzo: Confirmed.
Petra: Confirmed.
Shahid: Confirmed.
Vykos: Confirmed.
Cyscek: Confirmed.

So. 12 vamps listed. 7 confirmed, one probable, 2 possible, 2 unknown.
Zero confirmed _not_ to be in the set...

-John Flournoy

Messages.Author: John P.
Messages.Body:
So as of Today (April 28)
we have 35 vampires revelaed to us of 50 in the set
(http://www.distrimagen.es/catalogo/book.asp?referencia=woc2651)

Of the 35 there appears to be 2 per clan plus an additional
if there's an advanced vampire of that clan. Panders however
only got 1 vampire. And for some strange reason the gangrel antitribu
got three.(just who does legbiter have incriminating photos on?)

This leaves us with:
2 Brujah + Advanced Theo Bell
2 Brujah antitribu
2 Gangrel + Advanced Beckett
1 Caitiff (could be 2 but assumed # pander = # caitiff)
2 Assamite
2 Followers of Set

35+13=48

Leaving us with 2
Perhaps 1 more advanced vampire (I've seen Hesha speculation)
and an extra caitiff? Anybody got any other speculation?
Can anybody tell me where the idea of 6 advanced vampires came
from?
Or are they counting Hannibal but not putting him on the list.
I recall when the printing error was first announced that the line
was that Hannibal advanced would appear in Gehenna. With
the exchange is this no longer true?

-JTP
